work.summary: Closed the bounded FINAL.20 HF2 product-master maintenance cycle. Products found in confirmed OCR sales/input/recovery reports now synchronize into the Analytics product master without inventory movement. Draft/unconfirmed OCR candidates are excluded. The Analysis inventory area now exposes searchable product-master and classification-confirmation entry points; vehicle stocktake search sees synchronized products. Product-name heuristics create reviewable classification proposals only, and product lists use natural product-code order followed by smaller detected package size. PR #121 merged and the dedicated regression gate passes on preview, production, and GitHub Pages.
implemented: Added product-master synchronization from confirmed report payload product rows across sales, input, recovery, and input_recovery report families.
Explicitly excluded reports whose status is not confirmed, preventing draft OCR candidates from entering product master.
Product sync preserves inventory events and quantities; it only creates/updates product metadata, aliases, and observed HOT/COLD compatibility.

Added product-name classification proposals for broad family and selected high-confidence attributes such as black coffee/unsweetened, low-sugar coffee, milk coffee, common containers, and inferred size band.
Classification proposals remain needs_confirmation until the user explicitly confirms or corrects fields.
Added searchable Product Master UI for product name, code, maker, category, and classification fields, plus an unconfirmed-classification entry point under Analysis > Inventory.
Installed common product list sorting as natural product-code order, then detected package size ascending, then maker/name.
Vehicle stocktake search receives the synchronized product list through the existing products.list() API and therefore finds confirmed OCR-discovered products.
Verified matching Vercel production deployment dpl_2E6Zj35tLsjafLSp4tmk6Ycv475Y is READY.
Dedicated product-master regression gate passes on production and GitHub Pages.
No DB/schema migration, report auto-confirm, inventory movement semantics change, Analytics engine change, or learned numeric forecasting change was introduced.

openItems: Use real field OCR-confirmed products and verify they appear in Product Master and vehicle stocktake search.
Confirm/correct product classification proposals as useful; do not treat unconfirmed proposals as authoritative product facts.
Continue accumulating real exact scored evidence before any learned numeric promotion.
nextAction: Return to normal VENDRIVE field use. Confirmed OCR-discovered products should appear in Product Master and stocktake search; classification proposals can be reviewed from Analysis > Inventory. Reopen engineering only for new field friction or sufficient numeric-promotion evidence.
